title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: joinery and stone
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Natural stone and porcelain benchtops
swms.task: Install natural stone and porcelain benchtops in the apartment kitchens, cutting sink and cooktop holes on site.

facts.silicaControls: Cut-outs are cut wet or with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn by anyone still at risk. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.

steps: Cut and finish stone and porcelain benchtops

rules.phrase: No engineered stone benchtops, panels or slabs are supplied, installed or processed
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 529A, s 529D
rules.quote: must not carry out ... work that involves manufacturing, supplying, processing or installing engineered stone benchtops, panels or slabs
